rationale: Candidate proposes source-registry changes, a model-catalog refresh, and documentation corrections only - no change to Runtime/stable behaviour, Router modules or adaptive tooling. Acceptable on zero-provider checks. One bucket is under mandatory security review (see EV-SEC).

cases.name: Security-flagged bucket human review
cases.method: The auto-mode monitor flagged the claude-hooks-permissions research AND verify agents as possible classifier reconnaissance. Its 24 claims are tagged security_review_required in claims.json. A human must review the agents' actual fetched sources (all official code.claude.com docs) and either clear or drop each claim.
cases.pass_criteria: Every security_review_required claim is explicitly cleared by a human before it informs any promoted text; none promoted silently.

cases.name: Source patch applies and is reversible
cases.method: Dry-run source-registry.patch.json against registry.json; confirm every add/update/retire id resolves and a rollback restores the pre-patch file hash.
cases.pass_criteria: All entries apply; rollback reproduces original registry.json hash.

cases.name: No stable doc cites the retired URL
cases.method: Grep the repo for the 1 retired URL (codex issue #8759).
cases.pass_criteria: Zero references, or updated to the current source.

cases.name: Model-catalog re-verification before catalog refresh
cases.method: Re-open the official provider doc for EACH of the 33 model-catalog claims (ids, aliases, context windows, effort levels, deprecations) at promotion time. Only then refresh Models/providers.json.
cases.pass_criteria: Every model fact re-verified against an official source; no fabricated id/number; live catalog refresh matches.

cases.name: Corrected claims reconciled with contracts
cases.method: Diff each of the 6 corrected_statements against Claude/Codex OPERATING_CONTRACT text; fix or explicitly defer each contradiction.
cases.pass_criteria: Every contradiction fixed or deferred with a reason.

cases.name: Version-sensitive sample re-verification
cases.method: Randomly sample 15 of the 244 version-sensitive claims and re-open the cited tier-1 source at promotion.
cases.pass_criteria: >=14/15 still supported; any failure blocks that bucket pending full recheck.

cases.name: Rejected claims stay out of guidance
cases.method: Confirm none of the 4 unsupported ids appear in proposed-changes.md or promoted text.

cases.name: Report source integrity + PDF URIs
cases.method: Every Sources-appendix entry appears in claims.json or the patch; rendered PDF exposes clickable URI annotations.
cases.pass_criteria: No orphan sources; PDF URI annotations > 0.
